Whatever this is, it has a real home: a component of its own goes to `blocks/<category>/`, a fetch goes to `hooks/`, a pure helper to `modules/utils/`, a shape to `modules/types/`, copy or a config map to `resources/`. "Only this screen uses it" is how a folder becomes a second codebase.
Import '@heroui/react' outside the vocabulary tier ΓÇö use the matching atom (vendor wrapped once); if missing, add an atom instead of importing vendor directly.
`AsyncContent` is retired ΓÇö thread `isSkeleton` to each leaf, and use AsyncContentEmpty/AsyncContentError from '@/components/composites/async/AsyncContent'.

JSX file without an `identity` prop on the root ΓÇö add `identity` with `tier` and `component` on the root frame/composite (see components/frames/_identity.ts); do not wrap with a hand-rolled data-tier div.
`WithClassNames<ΓÇª>` at sentence tier opens a className backdoor (BLOCK-4) ΓÇö push the difference down one tier and name it.
`WithClassNames<...>` is forbidden on a public house component. Replace the CSS door with a semantic API or named wrapper.
Prop `skeleton={<ΓÇª>}` is a hand-kept parallel skeleton tree that drifts from the real shape ΓÇö thread `isSkeleton` to each leaf so shimmer mirrors the loaded tree.
Do not pass `className` to house component `Skeleton`. Parent layout owns placement; use the parent principle or a named wrapper.
